/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p=json.load(open('.exp_agent/round_plan_01.json'))
r=json.load(open('.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json'))
expected=[]
for rule in p['rules']:
 for f in rule['files']:
  expected.append((rule['rule'],f['relative_path'],[(x['line'],x['column']) for x in f['locations']]))
actual=[(x['rule'],x['relative_path'],[(l['line'],l['column']) for l in x['locations']]) for x in r['entity_repairs']]
print('planned_groups',len(expected),'reported_groups',len(actual),'status_values',sorted(set(x['status'] for x in r['entity_repairs'])))
print('coverage_match', sorted(expected)==sorted(actual), 'locations', sum(len(x[2]) for x in actual))
print('missing', sorted(set(expected)-set(actual)))
print('extra', sorted(set(actual)-set(expected)))
for x in r['entity_repairs']:
 for k in ['owning_entities','invariants','evidence','transformation']:
  if not x.get(k): print('empty',x['rule'],x['relative_path'],k)
PY"
